purpose: Attributable pre-race research annotations for a future experimental RaceLab model. NOT calibrated probabilities, and NOT an official results feed.

dataWarnings: Many vendor 3200m records can combine flat and jumping starts; do not use them as flat distance records.
Some vendor distance band definitions are unknown.
The source ratings may already incorporate carried-weight effects; independent weight adjustment disabled.
All analyst qualitative tags are hypotheses, not known performance coefficients.
Jockey changes or scratchings after this snapshot must be manually verified.
A source article written earlier than final acceptances lists Point Of Law at 51kg; final is 53kg.
Do not copy or redistribute proprietary per-runner form tables without verifying source licence.
No 2026 Melbourne Cup outcome has occurred as of this snapshot.

optionalResearchWhatIfPilot.modelStatus: Uncalibrated exploratory sensitivity. Disabled by default; cannot establish a betting edge.
recommendations: Keep the raw published rating/strength unchanged and derive a separate scenario strength.
Prefer historyMode=off for pilot versus baseline because condition evidence can overlap.
Only apply softScale when going=soft; do not assume it generalises to heavy.
Use the same evidence rule for all 24, regardless of betting shortlist.
optionalResearchWhatIfPilot.disclaimer: Exact values from a toy transformation using the submitted v0.10.0 source. Not real-world probabilities and not validated out-of-time.
